name: topbar
title: Topbar
description: The header of an application screen: full width and sticky, a bottom border instead of a shadow, leading (a SidebarTrigger or a breadcrumb), centre (search or a command trigger) and trailing slots, and an optional brand. The centre collapses to `centerCompact` on narrow screens. Glass gives it a translucent chrome fill.
docs: `<Topbar brand={…} leading={<SidebarTrigger controller={sidebar} collapsed={collapsed} />} center={<CommandDialogTrigger controller={search} shortcut="mod+k">Search</CommandDialogTrigger>} centerCompact={<CommandDialogOpenButton controller={search} variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Search">…</CommandDialogOpenButton>} trailing={<UserMenu />} />`. It renders `<header>`, which is the page's banner when it isn't inside `<main>` or a section. It sticks to the top of its scroll container; in a shell that owns the scroll (`fixed inset-0 flex flex-col`, the content `overflow-y-auto`), it simply sits first.
